clips.title: The story
paras: Deathguard Dillinger is a Forsaken sentry stationed in Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Standing watch over the town's perimeter, he directs newly arrived undead toward necessary services and tasks recruits with keeping the local Scourge remnants at bay.

As a member of the Forsaken Deathguard, Dillinger stands at the entrance of Brill, serving as both a frontline protector and an orienting guide for travelers emerging from Deathknell. He provides directions to town amenities such as the inn, the town hall, and local trainers, helping newly awakened undead navigate their new reality under the Dark Lady's rule.

Dillinger actively enlists capable adventurers to purge lingering mindless Scourge from the nearby farms and mills. Through assignments like cullling rotting ghouls and reclaiming infested facilities, he seeks to establish a buffer zone of security around Brill, ensuring the fledgling Forsaken settlements can endure against unending undead predation.
